name: @educateos/zip
description: EducateOS bounded ZIP reader and deterministic writer: entry, size and compression-ratio caps checked before anything is inflated, refusal of unsafe paths, encryption, ZIP64 and overlapping entries, a filter so unwanted entries are never inflated, and a streaming writer (with ZIP64 past its limits) for archives too large to build in memory. Shared by the Common Cartridge and OneRoster importers. A library, not a deployable Worker.
